observed: LCN02 fixed landing results come from actual compute_saa_field calls and both select e0 with seed 1.
The fixed histories have identical vocabulary, edge inventory, learner strengths, and distribution by edge key; only e2/e4 endpoints differ.
The disconnected remote-edge rewire changes no landing or projected local view.
Production propagation omits the positive incoming edge because adjacency is keyed only by edge.source.
The counterfactual only describes bounded reachability and retains each edge's original semantic source, relation, and target.
The cap fixture omits e7 upstream; projection reflects contributions supplied by FieldResult and does not recover e7 or the alternate deduplicated e3 path.
